name: makemyadd-repo-root
description: Repo root guard — the actual app lives in client/. This file exists to fail loudly if you accidentally run npm/pnpm/yarn install from the repo root.

scripts.preinstall:
node -e "console.error('
[STOP] Do not install from the repo root.

The app lives in client/. Run:

  cd client && pnpm install

If you are a tool (Sentry wizard, shadcn CLI, etc.) that landed here by accident, cd into client/ first.
'); process.exit(1)"
